title: BUILD 3 -- re-ask SLAKE_closed / VQA_RAD_closed / PATH_VQA_closed as OPEN TEXT and test whether the FROZEN verifier's best-of-8 pick beats greedy on them.
not_abstention: every arm answers every item; an UNPARSED answer is graded WRONG, never withheld.

G1_grader.note: published cells are 4-dp rounded, so a deviation at 1e-5 is rounding. Any non-zero row disagreement is a grader defect and fails the test.

verifier.backend: HF transformers (vLLM drops all 192 visual.* LoRA modules)

image_disjointness.title: BUILD 3 image disjointness: frozen verifier training images vs the three NEW closed eval cells
image_disjointness.currency: md5 of DECODED RGB pixels with a 'WxH|' prefix -- pixhash() verbatim from src/training_methods/build_disjoint_verifier_split.py:66
image_disjointness.note: the L1 pool is a SUPERSET of the examples the verifier actually sampled (10,364 composition-matched draws), so a zero here is conservative. Where the intersection is NON-zero the analysis reports BOTH the full cell and the IMAGE-DISJOINT subset, and the image-disjoint subset is the honest number.
image_disjointness.why_the_published_split_did_not_catch_th: artifacts/verifier_disjoint_split.json proved disjointness against the three OPEN eval sets only; SLAKE_closed / VQA_RAD_closed were not eval surface then. VQA-RAD and SLAKE split train/test by QUESTION, not by image, so the same picture carries both an open training question and a closed test question.

secondary_self_consistency.title: SECONDARY -- self-consistency (majority vote over 8 T=0.4 samples) vs 7B greedy on the two intrinsically multiple-choice cells
secondary_self_consistency.prompt: deployed MedEvalKit get_multiple_choice_prompt (direct), fullres, no system prompt

IS_THIS_THE_OLD_PMC_GRADER_ARTIFACT.why_the_question: artifacts/unified_pipeline_2026-08-12.json reports +0.0132 SIG on PMC-VQA that was ENTIRELY a defect in MedEvalKit's PMC answer extractor ('any arm graded pick == gold collects +0.0102 of free grader defect on this cell'). This round's PMC number rounds to the same +0.0132, so the coincidence must be discharged, not ignored.
IS_THIS_THE_OLD_PMC_GRADER_ARTIFACT.answer: NO -- four independent reasons, all readable above:
IS_THIS_THE_OLD_PMC_GRADER_ARTIFACT.1_zero_unparsed: the defect fires on responses the extractor cannot parse, and the unparsed letter rate here is 0.0 (greedy) and 0.0 (sampled). The mechanism has no surface to act on.
IS_THIS_THE_OLD_PMC_GRADER_ARTIFACT.2_same_grader_both_arms: the 2026-08-12 defect was a BETWEEN-GRADER confound -- the option branch was scored pick==gold while its baseline went through the defective extractor. Here BOTH arms are scored by BOTH graders on REAL generated response strings; the majority arm grades the raw response of the first sample carrying the plurality letter, never a synthetic string.
IS_THIS_THE_OLD_PMC_GRADER_ARTIFACT.3_both_currencies_agree: the win is present under letter_em AND under the harness's own judge_multi_choice; the 2026-08-12 positive was harness-only.
IS_THIS_THE_OLD_PMC_GRADER_ARTIFACT.4_defect_shrinks_it: the DEFECTIVE harness grader gives the SMALLER delta (+0.0100) than the repaired letter_em (+0.0132), so the defect is suppressing this effect, not manufacturing it.
IS_THIS_THE_OLD_PMC_GRADER_ARTIFACT.5_different_method_entirely: this arm is training-free MAJORITY VOTE with no verifier and no 32B; the 2026-08-12 arm was a verifier fusion over the prompt's given options.

SKILL_above_random_pick_floor.metric: SKILL = (SELECTED - random_pick_floor) / (oracle@8 - random_pick_floor): the fraction of the headroom ABOVE A RANDOM PICK that the verifier converts. 0 = no skill, 1 = oracle. sel_eff is NOT comparable across these cells: a near-unanimous pool makes a RANDOM pick score near oracle by construction, so a high sel_eff on a yes/no cell is COVERAGE, not signal.
SKILL_above_random_pick_floor.basis: primary arm openPRJ_s8; image-disjoint subset wherever the cell shares images with the verifier's training pool

POOL_DEGENERACY_why_the_skill_is_zero.note: distinct normalised answer strings produced across the WHOLE cell (all items, all 8 slots), and the fraction of items whose 8-sample pool holds >= 2 distinct strings. The open cells the verifier was built for are contested on 73.6% of items; these cells are contested on 16-24% and emit a handful of strings in total.

reformat_vs_deployed_operating_point.question: does the REFORMAT alone -- a prompt change, zero extra compute -- beat the DEPLOYED operating point?
reformat_vs_deployed_operating_point.deployed_operating_point: closedD_g_full = MedEvalKit's own prompt for the cell at FULLRES, regenerated in THIS session's engine (the matched control the +-0.008 reproducibility caveat requires)
reformat_vs_deployed_operating_point.why_a_positive_delta_is_conservative: the open arms run at cap320, i.e. 1/4 the pixel budget of the deployed fullres point, so they are CHEAPER than the thing they are being compared to
reformat_vs_deployed_operating_point.status: the open-vs-closedD_g contrast is PRE-REGISTERED; the vs-fullres contrast and the yes-bias decomposition below are POST-HOC and exploratory

MEASURED_prefill_cost.title: BUILD 3 -- MEASURED prefill length per arm; is the reformatted open arm actually cheaper than the deployed operating point?
MEASURED_prefill_cost.currency: prefill tokens = len(input_ids) from the Lingshu-7B processor on the byte-identical request the generator built
MEASURED_prefill_cost.decode_is_not_the_cost: every arm decodes 3.0 generated tokens (artifact descriptives), so prefill is the whole per-question cost difference

sample.rule: seeded uniform draw without replacement over the cell's items

PERMUTATION_NULL_arm_multiplicity.title: BUILD 3 permutation null for arm x cell multiplicity
PERMUTATION_NULL_arm_multiplicity.null: the verifier's pick is replaced by a uniformly random slot; the statistic is max over the nine (cell, arm) combinations of (SELECTED - greedy)
PERMUTATION_NULL_arm_multiplicity.note: the PRE-REGISTERED primary endpoint is a single fixed comparison and needs no correction; this guards the reader against the best-looking of the nine arms reported alongside it

COST.unit: Lingshu-7B forward-equivalents per question; the always-7B baseline is 1.0

conventions.as_charged: 1 FLOP-eq per generated candidate + 1 per verifier forward (artifacts/cost_decomposition_2026-08-12.json)
conventions.measured: generation of N=8 at cap320 = 2.37 FLOP-eq and each verifier forward at cap320 = 1.0809 FLOP-eq, both from artifacts/verifier_restructure_2026-08-16.json (cost_constants and Q1_generation_cost_and_prefill_sharing.per_config['count|default'])
conventions.which_to_quote: the MEASURED one. The as-charged column exists only so this artifact can be lined up against the project's older numbers.

COST.verifier_forwards_are_measured_here: read verbatim from the n_forward field src/cascade_methods/closed_as_open_score.py wrote
COST.why_the_verifier_is_cheap_here: the scorer scores each DISTINCT surface answer once, and these pools are degenerate, so the verifier costs 1.17-1.29 forwards here against 3.823 on the three OPEN cells (artifacts/verifarch_integrated_2026-08-04.json). That is a symptom of the failure, not a win.
COST.reformat_only_arm: openMEK_g / openPRJ_g cost ONE generation forward and, measured, 0.38-0.60x the deployed operating point's prefill -- see MEASURED_prefill_cost.

VERDICT.rule: a cell COUNTS toward the claim only if SELECTED - GREEDY is positive with a 95% paired-bootstrap CI excluding 0 in BOTH currencies (32B judge AND the length-neutral normalised exact match).
VERDICT.claim_scope: 3 open cells + 0 reformatted closed cells = 3 of 8 reporting cells
VERDICT.one_line: REFUTED. Re-asking the closed cells open-ended adds 0 of 3 cells to the verifier claim. The frozen verifier converts 30.6% of the above-random headroom on the three OPEN cells it was built for, and SLAKE_closed +9.9%; VQA_RAD_closed -7.9%; PATH_VQA_closed -1.8% here -- i.e. nothing.
VERDICT.why: the reformat never created the regime it was meant to test. Removing the answer space from the prompt did NOT widen the candidate pool: see SKILL_above_random_pick_floor -> POOL_DEGENERACY_why_the_skill_is_zero -- the model answers yes/no whether or not it is told to, so these cells emit a handful of distinct strings cell-wide against 3,919 on the open cells, and are contested on 16-24% of items against 73.6%. Candidate PROVENANCE was the hypothesis; candidate DIVERSITY is the operative variable, and the prompt does not control it.
VERDICT.the_positive_that_did_survive: a PROMPT-ONLY change with no verifier and no extra forward pass: dropping MedEvalKit's "Please output 'yes' or 'no'" instruction. See reformat_vs_deployed_operating_point and MEASURED_prefill_cost. It is not a verifier result and must not be reported as one.
